brief:
The Quincy Institute for Responsible Statecraft has raised questions about the future direction of American foreign policy in the Middle East, focusing specifically on how Washington will manage its relationships with Iran and Israel. The framing suggests considerable uncertainty about the path forward as regional dynamics continue to shift.

The institute, which specializes in noninterventionist foreign policy analysis, appears to be launching a substantive examination of potential policy directions and their implications. The inquiry reflects broader debate within policy circles about how to balance competing American interests and long-standing commitments in a strategically complex and volatile region where the stakes remain high.
title: Quincy Institute examines US policy options toward Iran and Israel
